Our plan today was to do a night dive but they called it off because the current was too strong. No worries, we researched some companies for the dive tomorrow and road around town. We took a dip in the pool to cool off then headed for the beach for lunch. We decided to eat at a nice resort overlooking the ocean. I'm not sure why I keep getting margaritas when they have hardly any liquor in them. We took a nap in the hammock at the beach and then back to the pool.



Several beers, pizza, and a free shot of Jauger later we headed back to our AC room and watched a movie. Am I finally feeling a buzz? It's so hard to get drunk in this heat. It's not that I'm not trying, I just can't drink fruity drinks and apparently the alcohol isn't as strong down here. A great way to spend a day in paradise. We don't usually relax this much so when we do it, we do it right. We are going to have another long day tomorrow getting up at 430 for our dives at Turneffe.
